title: Getting Started with Tailwind CSS in Django
author: Alex Rivera
content: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework packed with classes like flex, pt-4, and text-center. When integrated with Django, it makes template design incredibly swift.
summary: Learn how to seamlessly integrate and style your Django templates with Tailwind CSS utility classes.

title: Mastering Django Template Filters
author: Sam Smith
content: Django templates offer powerful filters out of the box. Filters like |safe allow raw HTML rendering, while |truncatechars manage text overflows gracefully.

title: The Mystery Post
content: This post contains plain text without HTML layout, meant to test your fallback mechanics.
summary: An anonymous piece testing missing values.
